newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy PTTEP on weakness - KTT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy PTTEP on weakness - KTT.

text.p: Investors should buy shares of Thai energy firm PTT Exploration and Production Plc if the stock eased on the Thai stock exchange, brokerage Krungthai Thanakit Plc said.

"There is some risk to buying PTTEP at this time. However due to its strong probable growth with a potentially attractive reserves base and production profile, we are reluctant to recommend selling this stock...nonetheless longer-term potential suggests that we recommend a Buy on Weakness," Krungthai Thanakit said in a report.

Krungthai Thanakit said PTTEP's risks included the probability that rising expenses and slowing sales growth would lead to its disappointing earnings in 1997, while crude oil price declines traditionally hurt energy exploration and production stocks.
PTTEP reported a 1.08 billion baht profit in 1996 against 956 million in 1995. The brokerage firm estimated its 1997 earnings would rise to 1.23 billion baht, rising to 1.51 billion in 1998.

"We expect PTTEP will experience flat earnings in 1997...if crude oil prices decline further in 1997, this should negatively affect PTTEP's stock price. From a historical perspective, stock prices of E and P companies are likely to perform poorly during a period of declining oil prices," the report said.

But it said the potential for longer-term gains woudl underpin the stock. "The company's production capacity will increase slightly between 1996 and 1997 but significantly for 1998-2001. As a result, we expect to see substantial growth in sales and earnings."
PTTEP rallied two baht to 316 by mid-Friday afternoon against an overall weak market.
